note: Analyst recommendations adapted from the UNGA81 AI Strategic Review. Fixed scope: 2026, all groups. Each link opens the dashboard view that holds the supporting statements.

items.title: Frame AI messaging around universal participation and practical capacity
items.text: Common rules and a role for the UN are the most frequent themes, and many speakers tie them to an equal voice for all countries in rule-making. Messaging should link global rules to concrete capacity support.

items.title: Route military AI demands to disarmament processes
items.text: Calls on autonomous weapons and military AI fall outside the non-military Panel and Dialogue. Reference the appropriate disarmament processes in Secretary-General messaging.

items.title: Engage sceptical delegations directly
items.text: A small group of addresses questions regulation or global approaches to AI. Engage these delegations directly rather than presuming consensus.

items.title: Track competing institutional models
items.text: Proposals range from a UN convention to safety and verification regimes, new bodies and venues outside the UN. Track convergence and unresolved differences across these models.

items.title: Give the proposed Global Fund a clear financing path
items.text: Digital-divide and capacity concerns cluster together, yet explicit support for the proposed Fund is rare. Link the Fund to national AI strategy support and keep general capacity calls distinct from Fund endorsement.

items.title: Cover language, resource footprint and concentration in assessments
items.text: Speakers raised language representation, the resource footprint of AI and the concentration of computing, data and patents. Consider these gaps in forthcoming assessments.

items.title: Prepare concrete deliverables for the next session
items.text: Supporters of the Dialogue sit alongside a reservation that dialogue creates no obligations, while others ask for common safety requirements, testing and incident reporting. Shared testing and incident-reporting practices are candidate deliverables.
